comparison: Compare saved project commit with upstream Python ASTs, ignoring comments, docstrings, and source formatting. Cross-file LLM copies are compared to their upstream source. Current uncommitted comment additions do not affect classification.
authorship_limit: PROJECT identifies differences in the saved project copy; it does not establish personal authorship or recover deleted local commits.

markers.PROJECT ADDED: New definition or executable block absent from the corresponding upstream source.
markers.PROJECT MODIFIED: Existing definition or block changed relative to the corresponding upstream source.
markers.UPSTREAM COPY: Inherited code copied to another path; unchanged definitions are not marked as project additions.
markers.PROJECT TEXT ONLY: Only trailing whitespace inside a string literal differs; not an implementation change.
